findings.title: Duplicate input paths: requested keeps duplicates but receipts account for distinct paths only
findings.evidence: panelBridge.ts deliverBatch: distinct = [...new Set(requested)] is what targets receive and what normalizeReceipt checks, while the returned outcome.requested retains duplicates; the docblock concedes this; no test pins it.
findings.consequence: For [a, a, b], requested has 3 entries but delivered + declined has 2, so a caller checking N in against N accounted for sees a mismatch. It also deviates slightly from 'each target receives the full ordered list'.
findings.minimal_fix: Set outcome.requested to distinct, or document that callers must dedupe, and add a test for the chosen behaviour.

findings.title: isBatchAvailable is not reactive across multiple channels
findings.evidence: isBatchAvailable calls channel.resolve() once and does not use useSyncExternalStore; only useViewerBridges and useTerminalBridges subscribe.
findings.consequence: A multi-channel batch action's disabled state can go stale unless the caller also re-renders via a bridge hook. This is a trap for phase-wbf-05; the ADR's 'availability hook reads null' is still satisfied.
findings.minimal_fix: Note in the isBatchAvailable docblock that it must be called during a render that subscribes via a bridge hook, or add a hook that subscribes to all listed channels.

findings.title: uv run pytest gate exits 1 on an environment-dependent test unrelated to the diff
findings.evidence: 06-gate.txt lines 76-100: test_run_review_checks.py::test_an_unwritable_worktree_parent_is_refused 'DID NOT RAISE Refused'; it chmods a directory to 0o500 and the runner is root (/tmp/pytest-of-root/). The diff touches only ts/src/stage/.
findings.consequence: manifest.result reads 'failed' although every phase verification command passed; the gate record shows a red the phase did not cause.
findings.minimal_fix: None in this phase. Run the gate as a non-root user, or skip that test when running as root.
